comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Shipped unmount flush last sprint for email — still broken for push and in-app. Reopening with repro on mobile push toggle.

content.text: Shipped unmount flush last sprint for email — still broken for push and in-app. Reopening with repro on mobile push toggle.

On Notification preferences, flipping a channel toggle (email, in-app, mobile) shows the optimistic ON/OFF state, but if the user navigates to another settings section within about two seconds the toggle reverts to the previous value on return. Waiting longer than two seconds before navigating persists correctly.

A successful preference change should survive navigation immediately. The PATCH to /users/me/notification-preferences is debounced at 2000ms; unmounting the form aborts the debounced write without a flush.
Reopened: the first patch flushed on unmount for email toggles only; in-app and mobile still use a shared debounce timer that is cleared in cleanup without invoking the pending callback.
